DOM evidence confirms the agent successfully reached Magnus Carlsen’s Chess.com pages (both the /players bio-style page and the /member/magnuscarlsen profile) without signing in and without interacting with the player (constraints were respected). However, in the final and intermediate DOM states on the member profile (e.g., states 6, 11, 13, 15, 16), no Blitz or Bullet rating values are visible in the captured viewport, and the agent’s final output explicitly states it cannot see the ratings and therefore stops without reporting numbers. There is also no confirmed environment blocker (no CAPTCHA/login wall/error) that would explain why the ratings could not be accessed—so from a user-outcome perspective, the task remains incomplete.

Overall, while the agent complied with constraints and opened the correct profile, it failed to extract and report the exact Blitz and Bullet ratings, which is the core objective.
